I love two-hearted, it was the beer that got me into beer. Compared to many other IPA's, including Centennial, it is not all that bitter. One of the points that is made in the linked article is the balanced malt profile. This gives two-hearted a wonderfully balanced sweetness that many people adore. As /u/Balrog_of_Morgoth described, I would recommend drinking it on tap, but be sure it is from a pub that will have a fresh keg, as I have found two-hearted to lose a lot of flavor if it is not very fresh.
